description: This file defines the CampaignROIChartDashlet class, which extends DashletGenericChart to generate a custom dashboard widget for displaying ROI-related charts for marketing campaigns in SuiteCRM. It includes methods for configuring display options, constructing query data for charts, and rendering a bar chart using RGraph.

classes.name: CampaignROIChartDashlet
classes.description: A dashboard widget class for displaying ROI analytics for campaigns, extending DashletGenericChart.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Prepares and returns display options for the dashlet, populating campaign options from the database.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Generates the HTML and JavaScript code for rendering the ROI bar chart using data retrieved and processed within the method.

methods.name: constructQuery
methods.description: Constructs and executes SQL queries to gather campaign-related data such as total value, revenue, investment, budget, and expected revenue.

methods.name: prepareChartData
methods.description: Processes raw data into a format suitable for chart rendering, including labels, data points, and tooltips.
